a.lede: In a special episode of “Uncanny Valley,” we break down Jensen Huang’s resignation from Nvidia, what comes next for the company, and where the AI industry goes from here.
a.title: Jensen Huang Is Out. Will Nvidia’s Rivals Cash In?

b.lede: Huang built Nvidia as a family business but after the co-founder had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, its board faces a difficult decision For more than 30 years, Jensen Huang has been the seemingly unshakable public face of Nvidia. He co-founded the company as a young engineer in 1993 and oversaw its growth into a multitrillion dollar chipmaker
b.title: Jensen Huang’s image has been shattered. Could he be pushed out at Nvidia?
